gate.seam: audit(root, payloads=..., exists/listdir/read INJECTED) — the gate test passes the live registry; demos and unit tests pass fixtures

install_killers.detail: sw-vhc.js cached "./design-tokens.css" — the file lives one level up at apps/design-tokens.css; cache.addAll rejects on any 404, so the ENTIRE vhc shell (59 URLs) never installed. Every board page's offline guarantee was silently absent.

unregistered_pages.detail: the break-glass emergency-access page registered NO service worker — the one page that must work offline above all others

pre_wave_findings.resolution: path fixed to ../design-tokens.css; 10 payloads added to the vhc shell; 3 pages added to the app shell and gained sw.js registration; probe.html is a stated exclusion (diagnostic probe, run online by hand)

excluded.reason: IndexedDB/module diagnostic probe — run online, by hand, during support; caching it would pretend it is a product page

drills.drill: all cached, all resolvable — the honest steady state
one shell entry 404s — addAll rejects, the WHOLE shell never installs; killer named
a registered payload in no shell — invisible offline; gap named
diagnostic page deliberately uncached — exclusion is stated data with a reason

doctrine: cache.addAll rejects wholesale: ONE bad path uninstalls the entire offline guarantee — a manifest entry is a promise, and promises are gated.
A board cached without its payload renders 'loading…' forever offline — coverage is per-target, not per-page.
Exclusions are stated data with reasons; silence is not an exclusion.
The audit reads the real shells at export: if the estate drifts, this payload goes stale and the freshness gate names it.
